name: claude-ship
description: Distributes the ship workflow that turns a request into an Issue and implements it until green, together with its dependent skills (create-issue / issue-loop / code-review).

plugins.name: ship-session
plugins.description: A workflow that turns a request into a GitHub Issue and implements it in the same session until every acceptance criterion is met, verification is green, and the review has zero findings. It decides the goal (Issue / implementation / PR / merge) once before starting and stops there.

plugins.name: ship-session-jev
plugins.description: An add-on to ship-session that lets Jev (TypeSafe AI's System One model) decide the goal from the request and skip the Phase 0 question when its confidence is high. Optional and fail-open: without TYPESAFE_API_KEY, or when the API fails, it behaves exactly like ship-session. Requires ship-session.

plugins.name: graph-workflow
plugins.description: Breaks a task into a graph of nodes and edges and runs it deterministically in parallel with the Workflow tool. It shows the graph design for approval first and resumes midway on failure.

plugins.name: artifact-templates
plugins.description: Design templates for Artifacts, picked by purpose: a plan becomes a landing page, a review a technical report, an investigation a report or a dashboard, shipped work an implementation report. One dark-first base and a no-slop list keep pages consistent.

plugins.name: agent-cast
plugins.description: A mod that shows each running subagent and teammate as a character: one row per agent in a band above the prompt (face, type, task, current tool, elapsed time), and their faces at the head of the spinner line. Each agent type has its own face.

plugins.name: acceptance-progress
plugins.description: A mod that shows the progress of the issue you are working on: when the agent reads or edits a GitHub issue with gh, it reads the issue's checklists back from GitHub and shows above the prompt how many acceptance criteria are done and which remain.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: A mod that redacts secret-shaped strings (GitHub, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, AWS, Slack and Stripe keys, PEM private keys) to [redacted:<kind>] before they are kept in the conversation: your prompt before it is sent, with a toast that suggests rotating the key, and the model's response before it is stored.

plugins.name: yomiyasu-gate
plugins.description: A mod that runs the yomiyasu linter on the Japanese body of gh pr / gh issue create, edit and comment and of git commit before the Bash tool runs them, and sends the command back to the agent with the offending lines when the text breaks the rules. Fail-open: without the linter it lets everything through.

plugins.name: session-dashboard
plugins.description: A mod that shows the session at a glance in one pane: what needs attention, ship-session and acceptance progress, the current branch's PR (CI, review, unresolved threads), and the servers and containers started in this session. It also blocks mass-kill commands such as pkill -f, killall and docker stop $(docker ps -q).
